$comment: Invariants each scope's owner declares for this repository, read by the review harness. Format: a JSON object whose 'invariants' array holds one entry per invariant with 'id' (lowercase, unique in the file), 'scope' (an id from penguin/scopes.json), 'statement' (one line of plain text that must hold after every change) and 'protected' (true when a side-by-side difference goes to the scope's owner in person; false when absent). Each entry of 'examples' names a 'scope', a JSON 'file' inside that scope's paths and the 'invariants' of that scope the file bears on. An examples file names one of the scope's contracts and its recorded cases: {"contract": "path::symbol", "cases": [{"name": ..., "args": {...}}]}.

invariants.statement: Patrons who log in on one library tablet stay separate people
A published day's daily active users stay the same when later days' events arrive
An unsubscribe on any linked identity holds after a later signup subscribes the address by default
